MIYABISTS2_EVENT_GET_SLXD_EVENT.title: Trial of the Demon Blade
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_GET_SLXD_EVENT.pages.IN: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You seem to have entered a dream.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
The demon blade has no right to grant me honors.
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_GET_SLXD_EVENT.pages.DE: Knowing when to give up is also a choice. Obtain 1 card from 5 random cards.
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_GET_SLXD_EVENT.pages.CO: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You have reached the final stage of the trial.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
Perhaps you should not continue. Obtain 1 card from 3 random rare cards.
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_GET_SLXD_EVENT.pages.GE: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You have passed the trial. We shall meet again.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]Several breakers are discussing who the strongest breaker is.
"Hmm? Nangong Yu"
"It depends on the situation, but it's probably Nangong Yu"
"Probably Nangong Yu. If we include Liuyin though, the result might be different"
"Other than me and Liuyin..."
"It's me!", Jufufu suddenly joins the discussion and declares.
"Little junior sister, what do you think?"[/outline_color][/outline_size]
Your senior sister will reward you.
Are you sure it's not your senior sister?
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]Since you think so highly of me, little junior sister, I must show you what I can do![/outline_color][/outline_size]
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_OTHERWORLDLY_VOICE_EVEN: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]"Do you desire power? I can give it to you." A voice comes from nowhere.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
It might be worth a try.
This might not be a good thing.
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]"Very well, I will grant you power, along with a little gift."\nDo you want more?[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]The voice fades away, but something ominous remains in your deck...[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]"How greedy of you." The voice fades away with a hint of mockery.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You've gained power, but at what cost?[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]There's no such thing as a free lunch![/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You choose to stay away from the mysterious voice. Perhaps it was the right choice.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_STRANGE_HOLLOW_EVENT.pa: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]A hollow seems to lie before you, but why would there be a hollow here?[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]There seems to be quite a few good things here, but they've already been eroded.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
The eroded relic still radiates power.
There seem to be other agents ahead
Obtain a random Ancient Partner card.
Some eroded coins... but they can still be used.
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]Something bad might happen if you stay any longer. Better leave quickly.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]This is far too abnormal. Better not get close.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
MIYABISTS2_EVENT_LABYRINTH_GHOST_DOMAIN_: [outline_size=10][outline_color=black]Belle and Wise invite you to explore the [Divine Labyrinth] Papago Hollow. There seems to be plenty of good stuff inside, but it comes with no small amount of risk...\nWill you accept the commission?[/outline_color][/outline_size]
It might yield a fine haul.
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You enter the Papago Hollow alongside Phaethon.\nYou may return loaded, or you may fail at the very start.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You've scrounged up quite a bit... Perhaps it's not a bad idea to retreat now (obtain a random reward or a curse).[/outline_color][/outline_size]
The rewards may be rich, but so is the danger.
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black][jitter][red]The Old Hunting Dog, Uridimu[/red][/jitter] has locked onto you![/outline_color][/outline_size]
There's no choice but to fight.
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]You've temporarily shaken off the hound's pursuit. Will you continue...? The rewards ahead will be richer, but so will the risks.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]I have more important things to do right now. Maybe some other time.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
[outline_size=10][outline_color=black]Greed is not a good thing. Better quit while you're ahead.[/outline_color][/outline_size]
